    ScalarNode from LPF and the exceptional categories #

    The core of [mild] Theorem 3 for the small ray category P of a minimal representation-infinite distributive algebra, and for Pᵒᵖ, holds unless P or Pᵒᵖ contains an exceptional dumb-bell (DBExc) or the exceptional penny-farthing Q₂' (PFExc) (RayCat.coreHyp_of_exc, with the global facts bridged: noProjInj_small, noTiny_small, noTiny_small_op, noSplit_small). The remaining inputs are

    • LPFNode ([mild] LPF, over all finite ray categories);
    • ExcNode: for the exceptional categories, a zero-detecting lift for which the non-interlaced contours are deep or proportional (the standardness route).

    scalarNode_of_lpf_exc assembles ScalarNode.
